name: Banh khoai
summary: A turmeric rice-flour crepe with shrimp, a quail egg, bean sprouts, and pork belly, folded, with a salad and a peanut-and-pork-liver sauce.
origin: Hue. Vietnam Tourism places the crepe on Kim Long.
culture: It is the crepe on the north-bank road toward Thien Mu, eaten with a fresh salad and a thick sauce.
texture: A turmeric rice-flour crepe, folded over shrimp, a quail egg, bean sprouts, and pork belly.
taste: The sauce is peanuts and pork liver. The salad is fig, starfruit, and cucumber.
howToEat: Eat it folded, with the salad and the sauce.
where: Kim Long, on the way toward Thien Mu.

In Dong Hoi the cake is a different one. Du khách on 15 Mar 2023 and the provincial tourism portal describe a larger crisp rice-batter cake with pork, shrimp, and bean sprouts, and a sauce of pork, tomato, pineapple, and peanut. It is not the Hue crepe on Kim Long.
seoTitle: Banh khoai in Hue — the turmeric crepe on Kim Long
seoDescription: A turmeric rice-flour crepe with shrimp, pork, and a peanut-and-liver sauce, along Kim Long toward Thien Mu.
